svg.aria-label: Flow chart of how to play Salvage Rights: write and freeze your agent's instructions, then each day read the crew's message, copy it into Copilot, copy your agent's reply back, fill in the fields and press Send, until a deal is agreed or day 6 is reached.
svg.text: Read the crew’s message on this screen
Copy it into your Copilot chat
Copy that reply into the message box
Fill in the fields below it:
NO — THE CREW REPLIES, NEXT DAY
